faq.q1Q: Does MTD Buddy support limited companies?
faq.q1A: Partly. MTD Buddy files MTD ITSA quarterly updates for sole traders and MTD VAT returns for VAT-registered businesses, including limited companies. It does not file Corporation Tax (CT600), company accounts or the year-end Self Assessment return yet. Pricing: free — no monthly subscription and no per-filing fee.
faq.q2Q: What VAT schemes do you support?
faq.q2A: We support Standard, Flat Rate, and Annual VAT Accounting schemes, filed directly to HMRC via MTD-compliant APIs.
faq.q3Q: Can MTD Buddy file my year-end Self Assessment?
faq.q3A: Not yet. MTD Buddy files your MTD quarterly updates. The year-end final declaration, the annual SA100 return and property income are not available in MTD Buddy yet, so use HMRC's online service or other HMRC-recognised software for that step.
faq.q4Q: What is the CT600 and do I need it?
faq.q4A: CT600 is the Corporation Tax return every UK limited company must file with HMRC each year. MTD Buddy does not file it — use HMRC's Corporation Tax online service, an accountant or other software.
faq.q5A: Your credentials are never stored. We use them to fetch your records via a secure, encrypted connection and discard them immediately after.
faq.q6A: Online Self Assessment returns are due 31 January each year. VAT returns are due one month and seven days after each VAT period ends. MTD Buddy shows your MTD quarterly update and VAT deadlines from HMRC.

tasks.errNotAuthorisedTitle: HMRC has not authorised access to this record
tasks.errNotAuthorisedIntro: HMRC refused the request without saying why. These are the usual causes, most likely first:
tasks.errNotAuthorisedCause1: You are not signed up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. Having an HMRC account and a National Insurance number is not the same thing — MTD is a separate sign-up.
tasks.errNotAuthorisedCause1Cta: Check or sign up on GOV.UK →
tasks.errNotAuthorisedCause2: You signed up recently and HMRC is still processing it. This usually takes up to 72 hours.
tasks.errNotAuthorisedCause3: Your self-employment or property income source is not registered for MTD in your HMRC account. That is separate from connecting software.
tasks.errNotAuthorisedCause4: The National Insurance number on file belongs to someone other than the Government Gateway account you connected with.
